lines: Next is... "Then proceed 6 and verily insomnia is inevitable," hmm. Then it's probably this way.
I proceeded, following the note the broker had left.
What is it, Shishigami? If you speak too loudly, Will-o'-wisps will come after us again.
S-Sorry... about that. But is this okay? Deciding our path so easily...?
Shishigami asked, keeping her voice down apologetically.
Easily...? I'm just following what's written in this memo.
But... did you really solve that cipher the right way...?
Hmm... At least I think so... Well, even if I'm wrong, we'll just come back out at the starting point. So there's nothing to worry about.
Shishigami still looked a little doubtful.
Kotaro-sama, did you get the solution for this cipher from some old document...?
Following in suit, Shonosuke also looked only half-convinced.
Haha, if it had been an extremely difficult cipher, even I wouldn't get it right away. It's something we see all the time. When dialing numbers on a smartphone.

Shonosuke: Huh...?
Jisai: Eh? A smartphone...?
Shonosuke and Shishigami opened their mouths in disbelief.
Yeah. The biography said that the labyrinth resets itself whenever someone gets in, so the dead broker probably wrote this note.
...But that guy was not an expert on traps. That's why the cipher became this simple.
Exactly. When you dial a number on a smartphone, it's laid out a certain way, right?
And the numbers are laid out with the top row of 1, 2, 3, the middle row of 4, 5, 6, and then 7, 8, 9 below that.
And I thought that the four doors in each room - north, south, west, and east - correspond to the four buttons in the middle of each side of the layout - top, bottom, left, and right.
This was my guess based on the way the numbers and letters emphasized in the cipher were restricted to those four.
Shonosuke and Shishigami looked at each other as if they didn't quite understand yet.
For example hereーin the case of "verily insomnia is inevitable." I don't know what that means, but pay attention to the first letters of the words.
They're "viii," in other words, "eight" in Roman numerals. And "8" is at the bottom of the keyboard, so that means it's the south door.
I said and pointed at the door in that direction.
But how do you know the directions? In this labyrinth the magnetic field is so disturbed that it is impossible to get an accurate directionー
Take a closer look. There's a small engraving saying "South" on the frame above the door.
Blending in with the lavish decorations, each of the four doors had a small engraving with the direction.
I had noticed those engravings when we first walked in here.
I thought that there must be a reason that the direction was engraved on each door.
Meaning, if we opened the door in the correct direction, we should be able to get out of here.
I'm surprised... It looked like you were just moving forward blindly, I never thought you were making observations like that...
Hm? I guess it's kind of like my habit.
I returned their stares, perhaps surprised, perhaps dumbfounded, with a wry smile, and continued on my way.
